title: Get involved
metaDescription: Explore ministries, serving teams, generosity, and practical ways to belong to the life and mission of St John's Park.

sections.title: Get Involved
sections.body: Getting involved can begin with a first Sunday, but it grows through friendship, serving, generosity, and a shared commitment to the people around us.

image.alt: Church family smiling together outside St John's Park

sections.title: Church Life
sections.intro: Most people begin by turning up on a Sunday, then gradually finding the rhythms and teams that help them belong more deeply.

cards.title: Sundays and worship
cards.body: Come on a Sunday, stay for refreshments, and let relationships grow naturally as you get to know the church family.

cards.title: Park Kids
cards.body: Sunday groups and All In Sundays help children belong, explore faith, and grow as part of the whole church family.

cards.title: Park Youth
cards.body: Faith Explorers and Cornerstone create space for secondary schoolers to build friendships, ask questions, and follow Jesus.

cards.title: Park Communities
cards.body: Friendship, prayer, Scripture, and local care continue beyond Sunday through Park Communities and shared life together.

cards.title: Local care and welcome
cards.body: From food support to hospitality and community events, practical acts of love are part of how we serve Park.

sections.title: Midweek Gatherings
sections.body: Join us to pray each Monday–Friday at 8.00am for 30 minutes on Zoom (Meeting ID: 323 564 9987, Passcode: 483559). We also meet to pray on the first Sunday of the month from 10.00–10.30am in the church building before the service, and hold a quieter midweek Communion service on Thursdays from 9.30–10.45am.

sections.title: Serving
sections.body: There are many ways to help church life flourish each week, from welcoming and hospitality to worship, kids and youth, admin, cleaning, food support, creative work, and audio-visual help.
points: Food Bank, Lunch Club, and practical community care
Admin, buildings, sustainability, and behind-the-scenes support

image.alt: People serving and chatting together after church

sections.title: Giving
sections.body: Your generosity helps sustain Sunday gatherings, midweek ministry, practical support in the neighbourhood, and the long-term renewal of our building for future mission.
points: Give online through the Parish Giving Scheme.
Bring a gift on a Sunday or use the card machine at church.
Contact us if you would like to talk through regular giving or a specific gift.
Building gifts can be discussed with the church team where helpful.

image.alt: Worship team leading sung praise during a Sunday gathering

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.body: Whether you want to ask about serving, giving, kids and youth, or simply becoming part of the church family, we would love to help you find the right next step.
